PREMIER PLAY's prizes make it a game that pays many small prizes and few large ones. Of the prize money still unclaimed, most is in wins under $5,000. The prize counts change every day, but this design does not.

Each day without a top prize claim on "PREMIER PLAY", the remaining top prizes are spread across fewer unsold tickets. The number of tickets printed is fixed.

Everything here about "PREMIER PLAY" comes from official Virginia lottery numbers, current through November 12.
2414.headline: What type of game it is

2415.body:
"Double The Money" has two of three top prizes left and is about halfway through its run. About half of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, a larger share of the top prizes is left than of the tickets, which is a good sign.

The numbers for "Double The Money" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.

The most common win left on "Loaded with $2,000s" is $20. The second biggest prize left is $500, and 1,081 of those are still unclaimed. The prize table is what defines a scratcher, and this page counts every level of it.

If "Loaded with $2,000s" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
